rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Mood contract named — joyful creation, honoured not flattened
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: resolving mood too early steals the next beat's teaching moment. Not present — 'Start here' trick-share ('what's one trick you figured out...nobody taught you?') and 'How we work in this room' carry warm, collegial, non-punitive tone consistent with joyful creation; student leaves this file anticipating hands-on work on their own repo, which sets up the four exercises. Key Concepts recap is mood-exempt (recap/setup, not a teaching beat).

M1's contracted mood is joyful creation, not unease — rule is scoped to modules whose mood IS unease. Checked anyway: 'The agent's self-report is a hypothesis, not ground truth. Dig until you find what misrepresents' reads as diagnostic curiosity, not shame-language, so even if scored it would pass.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: titling on a failure word (fabrication/violation) trains the wrong takeaway. Not present — Big Idea leads on 'compound loop'; WYL verbs (Run/Introspect/Fix/Close/Compound) are all positive disciplines; Key Concepts bullets lead with the practice (failing test as proof, evidence-built rules, tracker conventions), never a failure word as the header.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity check — draft doesn't front-run downstream teaching moments
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: naming a downstream module's specific mechanic/skill spoils its felt teaching moment (most expensive error to catch late). Checked the two forward-leaning spots: (a) 'Next' section names M2's theme in general terms ('a second pass that pressure-tests the plan', 'catches...you'd cold-authorize') without naming the walk-down-branches/grill-me mechanic or the specific push-back structure — same genericity level as M2's own 'Next' section forward-referencing M3's judges/gates (plan-mode-done-right.md line 75), so this is house style, not a deviation. (b) optional pre-read 'agentic-engineering-progression.md' names the whole-arc shape (assistance→interactive→delegated→parallel→loops→system-improvement) in the abstract, matching the Ramp anchor's explicit instruction to 'borrow the posture, not the label' — it names no specific skill, exercise, or module mechanic by name, so it doesn't ripple a spoiler forward the way a named-skill reference would. No plan mode is taught (only its absence is stated, per the M1 'not a conflict' carve-out already recorded in strategy). No Skill/subagent content appears anywhere in the file, correctly deferred to M3.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategic themes recur in Key Concepts (≥2-3 module-specific instances)
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a Key Concepts section with no theme instances teaches tactics with no worldview underneath. Not present — clear instances of compounding (loop bullet), 90%-correct (/context bullet), self-aware+mirror (agent self-report bullet, plus 'reflection' language), and capture-your-world (tracker-conventions bullet, 'earn their own PR' in the CLAUDE.local.md bullet) — 4+ distinct theme instances, comfortably above the 2-3 floor.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Key Concepts shape — breadcrumbs (1-3, no Remember:/bold), survivors-first, no repeat across adjacent modules
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: breadcrumb on a bullet that shouldn't exist, or more than 3, turns memorable hooks into wallpaper; verbatim repeat across adjacent modules kills the hook. Not present — exactly 3 breadcrumb-shaped closing clauses at/near the 5-8 word target ('Context is what you put in it' / the maintainer-sanctioned Mirror/Ground clause per this fire's context / 'Rules grow from evidence, not blank pages'), no 'Remember:' label, no bold anywhere. Checked plan-mode-done-right.md's Key Concepts (adjacent module) for repeats — different themes and phrasing throughout, no verbatim or near-verbatim collision.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: What You'll Learn shape — capability register, theme verbs lead, grammar-fit, no apparatus
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: apparatus language (Bloom tags, mechanism tails, author-defence asides, didactic stamps) turns a capability bullet into curriculum-talking-about-itself. Not present — all 5 bullets are verb+concrete-object (loop/repo, agent's read, bug/PR, ticket, rule/file). 'Close' bullet's trailing fragment ('The first move outside the repo') is the exact carve-out (a) example named in the compendium itself. 'Compound' bullet ('Compound one rule from the session into ./CLAUDE.local.md') matches the compendium's own worked fix for the object-leads-with-destination failure mode verbatim in structure. 'Fix' bullet's brief qualifiers (tests-first, root-cause-driven, no plan mode) fall under carve-out (c), one line, bullet would be cryptic without it. No Bloom parentheticals, no mechanism tails, no author-defence asides, no taxonomy stamps.
